ns2:section.sectionText: Undergraduate and graduate students may enroll in the BB lecture and in one of the laboratory (BL) sections for 4 hours credit. This section will have distributed classroom attendance with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email from our department with specific attendance directives.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Engineering Physics or Physics or Teaching of Physics or Astronomy major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
